text: Product FAQ Basmati rice is available in the grocery section. Aashirvaad atta is available in the flour section. Surf Excel products are available in the home care section. Dove shampoo is available in the personal care section. Product availability may vary depending on current inventory.

Retail Store Return Policy Customers can return eligible products within 7 days of purchase. The original invoice or bill is required for returns. Products must be unused and in their original packaging. Damaged products should be reported within 24 hours of delivery. Certain personal care and hygiene products may not be eligible for return once opened. Refunds are generally processed to the original payment method.

Retail Store Information Our store has multiple sections for groceries, personal care, home care, electronics and clothing. The grocery section is located near the main entrance. The personal care section is located next to the grocery section. Customers can ask store staff for assistance in locating products. Store timings are from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM.
